title: Human XY Pad
subtitle: Multineumatic Spatial Controller & Real-Time Granular Synthesis Interface
description: An interactive gestural control system and digital musical instrument that transforms physical 3D positioning and body movement into real-time audio DSP parameters and granular synthesis.
longDescription: The Human XY Pad eliminates physical contact with traditional mechanical interfaces using an array of 6 ultrasonic sensors (HC-SR04) mounted on standardized rails and a modular granular synthesis engine in Max/MSP. The Arduino C++ microcontroller processes time-of-flight ultrasound signals, filters boundary noise, and calculates spatial multipoint averages across X and Y axes with sub-35ms latency. Axis X modulates the cutoff frequency of a low-pass filter (biquad~), while Axis Y controls the grain emission rate in Max/MSP.

architecture.captureHardware: Physical array of 6 ultrasonic sensors (HC-SR04) mounted on standardized rails delimiting a 2D spatial area (up to 150 cm per axis).
architecture.embeddedFirmware: Arduino microcontroller (C++) responsible for pulse triggering (10 µs), echo timing (pulseIn), boundary noise filtering, and spatial multipoint averaging.
architecture.audioEngine: Max/MSP patch featuring sample loading, grain generator (sub-patch p grano 10-100 ms duration), grain polyphony (Grand Random Pad Generator), and biquad~ / live.gain~ filtering.

roadmap.scope: Deployed functional prototype with 6 ultrasonic sensors, Arduino C++ processing, and Max/MSP granular synthesis.
Implementation of laser Time-of-Flight (ToF) sensors and Open Sound Control (OSC) protocol over Wi-Fi/UDP.
Modular industrial chassis design and 3D spatial polyphony support (Z-axis with overhead LiDAR).
